name: attention-workflow
description: EXPERIMENTAL, Claude-only. An attention-regulating development lifecycle — Frame, Design, Prepare, authorize, Implement, Verify, Deliver, Close — carried by one orchestration skill over local run state. Versioned grants are create-only and supersede rather than rewrite; an independent verifier derives the actual route itself and its verdict stays withheld until the operator commits a judgment; narrow PreToolUse guards deny grant rewrites and unauthorized pushes. Supersedes spec-flow while enabled.
